49.name: start_camera_target_position_transition
49.stack_evidence: func_001C9FE0 reads four values from the Script value stack, stores the duration and target X/Y/Z coordinates in camera transition state, and decrements Script stackTop by four
49.notes: func_001C9FE0 snapshots the current camera target at D_003C0E30 through D_003C0E38, stores the requested target at D_003C0DD0 through D_003C0DD8, resets elapsed time, and enables transition flag 0x1. func_001C9EC0 advances elapsed time and interpolates each coordinate through the camera easing function before rebuilding the camera. All 63 JP calls occur after command 513 enable_event_camera in the same entry; every call is followed by command 50 and then command 51 to start synchronized rotation and distance transitions.

50.name: start_camera_rotation_transition
50.stack_evidence: func_001CA418 reads four values from the Script value stack, stores the duration and target pitch/yaw/roll after converting the angles from degrees to radians, and decrements Script stackTop by four
50.notes: func_001CA418 normalizes each target angle to the range from -pi through pi, snapshots the current camera rotation, and enables transition flag 0x2. func_001CA090 derives per-tick angular increments from the starting and target rotations, advances and clamps all three axes, rebuilds the camera, and clears the flag once every axis reaches its target. All 63 JP calls immediately follow command 49 start_camera_target_position_transition and precede command 51; all use the same duration as command 51, and every observed roll is zero.

51.name: start_camera_distance_transition
51.stack_evidence: func_001CA720 reads two values from the Script value stack, stores the duration and target camera distance, and decrements Script stackTop by two
51.notes: func_001CA720 snapshots the current camera distance from D_003C0E80, stores the requested distance, and enables transition flag 0x4. func_001CA638 derives a per-tick increment from the starting distance, target distance, and duration; it advances and clamps the active distance, rebuilds the camera, and clears the flag at the target. All 69 JP calls use direct literal arguments with target distances 250, 350, 400, or 800. Sixty-three calls immediately follow command 50 start_camera_rotation_transition; the remaining six independently transition to distance 250 over 15 ticks.

52.notes: func_001CA888 snapshots the current field of view from D_003C0E84, stores the requested field of view, and enables transition flag 0x8. func_001CA7A0 derives a per-tick increment from the starting field of view, target, and duration; it advances and clamps the active value, rebuilds the camera projection, and clears the flag at the target.
